children: The financial sector underperformed the broader market in the third quarter, with the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF
falling 2.52%, compared with a 2.25% gain for the S&P 500 (
Among the 11 S&P 500 sector ETFs, financials ranked sixth during the quarter.
Seeking Alpha analyst

, Investing Group Leader for Ian's Inside Corner, said the weakness in financial stocks during the third quarter pointed to the rapid rise in interest rates as a potential source of stress for consumers, particularly amid higher inflation and a weak housing market.
He also noted that, at some point, higher rates could contribute to an economic slowdown, with potential ramifications across the financial sector.

Top financial sector performers of the quarter
On the individual front, PayPal

led financial stocks during the quarter, rising 16.85%. Bezek said that PayPal's gain was helped by M&A chatter, while the other major financial sector winners were concentrated in the exchanges category.
Intercontinental Exchange
followed with a 13.82% gain, while Coinbase Global
advanced 13.11%.

Bezek also noted that the Coinbase benefited from a renewed surge in cryptocurrency activity, while the stock exchanges benefited from solid trading volumes and a fading of some earlier concerns around AI disruption.
CME Group
and Cboe Global Markets
rounded out the top five gainers, rising 12.49% and 12.29%, respectively.

Top financial sector detractors of the quarter
On the other hand, Aon
led the sector’s declines, falling 22.62% during the quarter.
Cincinnati Financial
followed with a 15.95% decline, while Huntington Bancshares
American Express
and Erie Indemnity
rounded out the five biggest decliners, falling 14.60% and 14.07%, respectively.

On the losing side, Bezek said there were big declines in several insurers and regional banks, and he is particularly concerned on the banking side, as the sudden surge in interest rates is reminiscent of 2023.
At that time, he noted, Silicon Valley Bank and many peers failed as their balance sheets were caught off-balance by the big spike in rates.

Erie Indemnity
: -14.07%, Quant rating: Hold, with a score of 3.17 out of 5.
Looking Ahead
The financial sector enters the fourth quarter with performance still lagging the broader market.

Bezek added that if interest rates continue to surge, the sector could see a similar risk-off move in banking stocks, with investors again combing over each bank’s disclosures to analyze potential deposit-flight risk.
However, he added that if yields reverse, that would allow for a more constructive view on the sector.

According to Bezek, another key catalyst to watch will be how the IPO market looks ahead of several high-profile offerings. It will be a key factor in investment banking profits, along with driving trading volumes at the exchanges heading into 2027.
